description: A Dynamic Island for Windows 11 with AI coding tool quotas, usage tracking, music controls, and a system monitor.
notes: This is the portable package: it can update itself in place, which would replace files inside the Scoop-managed folder.
Turn off 'Check for updates automatically' in Settings > Updates and use 'scoop update brimdeck' instead.
Settings and the usage database stay in %LOCALAPPDATA%\BrimDeck and survive updates.
